serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Shanice asked me to talk to bot about investigating her origins.
I hope she doesn’t mind, because Shanice is really excited about it.
You: {f_botName}, would you mind if someone came over?
Bot: Yes. It could compromise us. 
You: Oh no, I’m talking about Shanice. The nun.
Bot: Oh.
You: She wants to come over and examine you a little.
Bot: Then no.
You: Why?!
Bot: I don’t want to be examined. 
You: Don’t be like that, it’s Shanice we are talking about. You met her before.
Bot: She screams a lot.
You: Well, that’s true, but she is a nice person deep inside. {{wi}}Very deep inside.
#bot.Expression.Angry
Bot: If you want to meet her that much can’t you just go to her like you always do?
Uh oh, she got mad all of sudden.
You: Shanice is my dear friend and she asked for a favour. Could you do it for me? Pretty please? 
#bot.Expression.NoAngry
#bot.Expression.Blush
Bot: I-If that’s the case, I guess she can come over if you promise you will not allow her to do anything weird to me!
#bot.Expression.Sad
You: Deal.
Somehow I managed to convince her… Shanice owes me a big one.
